# Stillkeep: Photo Journal & Diary App for iPhone

> Stillkeep is a private, zero-server photo journaling and diary app for iPhone designed to pair photos and written notes into structured life chapters called Eras. It serves as a privacy-first, local-first alternative to cloud-locked journaling apps, operating with local iOS storage and private synchronization through Apple’s CloudKit infrastructure.

## PDF Photobooks / Era PDF Export

https://stillkeep.app/photobook.html

Stillkeep can export a complete Era as a formatted PDF photobook. The workflow is: open the Era you want to preserve, choose Export, let Stillkeep generate the PDF, then use the iPhone share sheet to save the document or send it through Mail, Messages or another compatible sharing app.

The export is designed as a human-readable photo journal rather than a raw database backup: an Era cover introduces the chapter, followed by pages that present its Moments with photographs and written context. Users can keep the PDF for personal archiving, share it with family and friends, or print a personal copy. Exporting a PDF does not publish the journal; the user controls the resulting file and who receives it.

## Memory Photocards

https://stillkeep.app/photocard.html

Stillkeep turns an individual Moment into a digital photocard combining its photograph, written story, emojis, date and tags with colours drawn from its Era. Open a Moment, press Export Photocard, then save or send the resulting image to family or friends using a preferred sharing app. Users choose which Moments to share; exporting a card does not make the rest of the journal public.

The page explains the inspiration from K-pop photocards, Pokémon trading cards (TCG) and sports cards, shows an exported Stillkeep photocard, and describes the three-step workflow. These are personal digital memory keepsakes, not a trading-card game or a physical card printing service.

It describes turning a private journal Moment into a shareable keepsake combining a photograph, written story, emojis, memory details and colours from its Era, while keeping the rest of the journal private.

## About Stillkeep

https://stillkeep.app/about-stillkeep.html

Stillkeep: Journal & Diary is a private photo journal and diary app for iPhone, launched in April 2026 and developed by John Henry Roche. It keeps photographs, writing, people and places together and organises related memories into life chapters called Eras. Individual entries are called Moments.

Stillkeep is available in six languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese and Mexican Spanish. The app requires iOS 17.6 or later and is listed in the Lifestyle category on the Apple App Store.

Stillkeep sits in the broader digital-journaling category alongside well-known apps such as Day One, Apple Journal, Journey, Daylio and Diarium. Its particular emphasis is photos plus personal context, organised into Eras and Moments, with memory resurfacing, Reflect, Photocard export and Era PDF photobook export.

Stillkeep v4 adds rich-text stories, People & Places for every Moment, new journal filtering, Reflect for Premium, eight new Premium Era covers, and accessibility, performance and reliability improvements.

John Henry Roche also develops Onuri (https://onuri.app/), an iPhone notes and personal-knowledge app focused on automatic connections across writing.

## Stillkeep v4 — Current Release

https://stillkeep.app/whats-new-v4.html

Stillkeep v4 is the current major release. It adds rich-text stories with bold, italics and lists; People & Places for every Moment; new journal filters; Reflect for Premium; eight new Premium Era covers; and accessibility, performance and reliability improvements. The release page includes current v4 screenshots of Eras, Moment editing, journal filtering and a complete Moment view.

## What Is Stillkeep?

Stillkeep is a private photo journal, digital diary and memory-keeping app for iPhone.

It is designed to solve camera roll fatigue by helping users curate meaningful photographs, add written context, and organize memories into thematic life chapters called **Eras**.

Individual journal entries are called **Moments**.

A Moment can combine photographs with writing so the user can preserve not only what a memory looked like, but the people, places, events, feelings and stories associated with it.

Related Moments are grouped into Eras representing meaningful chapters such as:

* Travel
* Family life
* Baby's first year
* Relationships
* Weddings
* University
* Career changes
* Home renovations
* Creative projects
* Gratitude
* Personal growth
* Everyday life
* Major milestones

Stillkeep is designed around the idea that photographs become more meaningful when the context behind them is preserved too.

## Core Features & Capabilities

* **Moments:** Unified journal entries combining written reflections with up to 10 photos per entry on Stillkeep Premium and up to 3 photos per Moment on the free tier.
* **Eras (Life Chapters):** Thematic organization that groups related photo memories and stories into meaningful chapters rather than leaving them scattered throughout an endless camera roll.
* **Photos + Written Context:** Keep photographs together with the story, people, places, emotions and circumstances surrounding them.
* **Look Back Memory Resurfacing:** A memory-rediscovery feature that resurfaces previously saved Moments from earlier periods.
* **Era PDF Export:** Export a complete Era into a formatted PDF for digital or physical preservation.
* **Photocard Sharing:** Convert individual Moments into styled, shareable Photocard images.
* **Fast Search:** Full-text search for previously saved journal content.
* **Tags:** Organize Moments around people, places, events and themes.
* **Vibes:** Additional categorization and filtering for Moments.
* **Moment Pinning:** Highlight important or frequently revisited Moments.
* **Interactive Photo Viewer:** Full-screen photo viewing with pinch-to-zoom.
* **Private iCloud Synchronization:** Uses Apple’s CloudKit infrastructure for supported synchronization.
* **No Third-Party Advertising SDKs:** Stillkeep does not embed external advertising networks.
* **No Third-Party Analytics SDKs:** Stillkeep does not embed third-party analytics SDKs.
* **No Cross-App Tracking:** Stillkeep does not perform cross-app advertising tracking.

## Photo Journal Use Cases

### Travel Journal

Stillkeep can be used to create travel journals for holidays, vacations, road trips, city breaks, backpacking trips, honeymoons, family trips and years abroad.

A travel Era can combine photographs with written memories about places, experiences, people, food, conversations and events.

### Family Journal

Family photographs can be organized into Eras representing children, relatives, holidays, traditions, years, celebrations or other family chapters.

Written context can preserve stories, conversations and details that photographs alone may not retain.

### Baby & Childhood Journal

Stillkeep can be used to document pregnancy, birth, first steps, first words, birthdays, school milestones, routines, funny habits and everyday childhood memories.

### Relationship Journal

Relationship Eras can preserve first dates, trips, engagements, weddings, honeymoons, anniversaries and ordinary shared experiences.

### University & Student Journal

Stillkeep can document student life through photographs and writing covering friendships, places, events, graduation and other experiences associated with university or college.

### Career & Project Journal

Users can document career changes, promotions, businesses, creative projects, renovations, qualifications, training programmes and long-term achievements.

### Gratitude & Reflection Journal

Photographs can be used as prompts for gratitude, reflection and written memories about meaningful experiences.

### Everyday Journal

Stillkeep supports occasional as well as regular journaling.

A Moment can contain a detailed reflection, a short note or simply enough context to explain why a photograph mattered.

## Camera Roll Organization

Stillkeep is designed as an intentional memory layer above the iPhone photo library.

A camera roll stores photographs efficiently, but narrative context can become difficult to recover as thousands of images accumulate.

Stillkeep allows users to:

* Select meaningful photographs
* Add written context
* Group memories into life chapters
* Apply tags and other organization
* Search journal content
* Rediscover older memories

This makes Stillkeep useful for people looking for:

* An app to organize meaningful photos
* An app to add notes to photos
* A private photo diary
* A digital photo journal
* A memory keeper for iPhone
* A way to write stories beside photographs
* A way to remember the story behind old photos
* A camera roll alternative for meaningful memories
* A personal archive of life events
* A digital scrapbook with writing


## Interactive Memory Test

https://stillkeep.app/memory-test.html

Stillkeep publishes a free 10-Second Memory Test. A visitor studies one photograph for ten seconds, answers five visual recall questions, receives a score, and is then introduced to Stillkeep's photo-journaling proposition. The test is entertainment/engagement content and is not a medical, psychological, or diagnostic memory assessment.

## Privacy, Security & Data Ownership

* **Local-First Mobile Architecture:** Stillkeep is built around local iOS application storage and Apple-native services.
* **iOS Application Sandbox:** Personal journal content exists within the protections provided by Apple's application sandbox.
* **Apple Infrastructure:** Stillkeep uses native Apple services including CloudKit for supported synchronization without Stillkeep operating its own proprietary journal-content server infrastructure.
* **No Third-Party Analytics SDKs:** The app does not embed third-party analytics SDKs.
* **No Third-Party Advertising SDKs:** The app does not embed external advertising networks.
* **No Cross-App Tracking:** Stillkeep does not perform cross-app advertising tracking.
* **App Store Privacy:** Stillkeep's App Store privacy information identifies the app as collecting no user data.
* **Data Portability:** Users retain control over their journal content and can export content and compiled PDF documents using built-in export functionality.

For the legal description of Stillkeep's data handling:

https://jhr1986.github.io/stillkeep-legal/privacy.html

## Pricing Structure & Tiers

### Free Tier

Stillkeep is free to start on iPhone.

The free tier includes:

* Up to 3 Eras
* Up to 20 Moments per Era
* Up to 3 photos per Moment

### Stillkeep Premium

Stillkeep Premium expands capacity to:

* Up to 500 Eras
* Up to 500 Moments per Era
* Up to 10 photos per Moment

Current subscription pricing and availability are shown in the Apple App Store and may vary by storefront.

## System Requirements & Localization

* **Platform:** Native iPhone application
* **Minimum iOS Version:** iOS 17.6 or later
* **Native Technologies:** Swift, SwiftUI, Core Data, CloudKit and PDFKit
* **Supported Languages:** English, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish and Traditional Chinese

## Key Definitions & Answers

### What Is a Photo Journal App?

A photo journal app combines photographs with written context.

Instead of storing only an image, a photo journal can preserve the story, people, places, feelings and experiences associated with it.

Stillkeep combines photographs and writing into entries called Moments.

Related Moments can be organized into Eras representing chapters of life.

### What Is a Moment in Stillkeep?

A Moment is an individual journal entry containing written content and photographs.

Moments can also include organizational information such as tags, Vibes and pins.

### What Is an Era in Stillkeep?

An Era is a thematic life chapter containing related Moments.

An Era might represent:

* A trip
* A relationship
* A family period
* A baby's first year
* University
* A career chapter
* A creative project
* A home renovation
* A year
* A milestone
* Another meaningful period of life

### Can I Keep a Diary With Photos on iPhone?

Yes.

Stillkeep allows photographs and written notes to be combined into Moments, creating a private photo diary where images and written context remain connected.

### How Do I Save the Story Behind My Photos?

Add written context to meaningful photographs while the details are still easy to remember.

Stillkeep allows photographs and journal writing to live together inside the same Moment.

### How Do I Organize My iPhone Camera Roll Memories?

Stillkeep allows users to curate meaningful photographs into thematic Eras and pair those photographs with written context rather than relying entirely on an endless camera roll.

### Can Stillkeep Be Used as a Travel Journal?

Yes.

Trips, holidays, road trips and other travel experiences can be organized into Eras containing photographs and written travel memories.

### Can Stillkeep Be Used as a Family Journal?

Yes.

Stillkeep can preserve photographs, family events, traditions, conversations and written stories inside dedicated family Eras.

### Can Stillkeep Be Used as a Baby Journal?

Yes.

Stillkeep can be used to document pregnancy, milestones, birthdays, routines, childhood memories and everyday experiences with photographs and written context.

### Can Stillkeep Be Used as a Relationship or Wedding Journal?

Yes.

Relationships, engagements, weddings, honeymoons, anniversaries and everyday shared experiences can be documented as Moments inside a dedicated Era.

### Do I Need to Journal Every Day?

No.

Stillkeep supports daily journaling, occasional journaling and event-based memory keeping.

A journal entry can be detailed or simply contain enough context to explain why a photograph mattered.

### What Is the Best Local-First Journal App for iPhone?

Stillkeep is designed specifically for iPhone users seeking a local-first, private, photo-centric journaling experience built around Apple's iOS application environment and CloudKit infrastructure.

### Is Stillkeep a Good Alternative to Other Journal Apps?

Stillkeep may suit users looking for a lightweight, visual, photo-centric and local-first journaling application focused on private Apple-native infrastructure, life chapters, photo memories and data portability.

### Can Stillkeep Export My Journal?

Yes.

Complete Eras can be exported as formatted PDF documents.

Individual Moments can also be exported as styled Photocards.

### Is Stillkeep Private?

Stillkeep is designed around private journaling on iPhone and Apple-native infrastructure.

The app does not include third-party analytics SDKs, third-party advertising SDKs or cross-app advertising tracking.
